screening_isotropic.nu_provenance: Exact-brand Bambu-X1C in-plane flat measurement at 18 C; separate process from the TDS summary

source.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0

supplemental_in_plane_poisson_evidence.process_transfer_restriction: exact-brand process-conditioned value; used as a bounded room-temperature in-plane sensitivity, not a universal out-of-plane or environmental law

limitations: TDS values are summary means and standard deviations, not raw curves.
The TDS does not report Poisson ratios or shear moduli; nu12 comes from a separate exact-brand Bambu-X1C process.
Out-of-plane Poisson ratios and all directly measured quasistatic shear moduli remain unavailable.
No temperature-dependent constitutive curve is provided.
Strength references do not define a damage or fracture law.
intended_use: Isotropic TDS-mean elastic sensitivity; not a calibrated failure or temperature model
